settings.headline: Part of the Senseless System
settings.body:
Each bundle pairs a strength-matched Comfort Cream, Comfort Gel and Comfort Spray with the Foaming Cleanser — the same products sold individually, assembled and picked as one unit. Choose the bundle that matches your appointment and your practitioner's guidance. Numbing is a cosmetic preparation that supports comfort.

Senseless is a cosmetic product, formulated in the United Kingdom. It is not a medicine.

settings.question: What's in the bundle?
settings.answer: A strength-matched Comfort Cream, Comfort Gel and Comfort Spray, plus the Foaming Cleanser for before and after. The exact sizes are listed above.

settings.question: Is the bundle cheaper than buying the items separately?
settings.answer: Yes — each bundle is priced below the total of its items bought individually. The saving is shown on this page.

settings.question: Can I mix strengths in one bundle?
settings.answer: Each bundle is a single strength tier — Clinical, Advanced or Professional — across all three formats. For a different mix, buy the items individually.

settings.question: Which bundle should I choose?
settings.answer: Match the strength tier to your appointment and your practitioner's guidance. Starter and Ultimate differ by the cream and gel sizes; the spray and cleanser are the same in both.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a cosmetic product, formulated in the United Kingdom.
